input.baseline: 60 kg for 5 reps, 3 sets. I lift 3 days a week, with a rack and a spotter.

baselineMeasurements.sourceQuote: I lift 3 days a week, with a rack and a spotter.
60 kg for 5 reps, 3 sets. I lift 3 days a week

options.rationale: From 60 kg to 80 kg for 5 is a 20 kg gain. Adding about 2.5 kg every 2-3 weeks on the heavy days, with one lighter technique day each week, gives a patient path that leaves room for repeat weeks.
assumptions: You keep lifting 3 days a week with the rack and a spotter.
Your 60 kg x 5 x 3 is a solid, repeatable effort today.
Progress slows past 70 kg, so later steps may need repeat weeks.
Sleep and recovery stay similar to now; 80 kg is a target, not a promise.

phases.title: Base and form
phases.progressCheck: Complete 65 kg for 3 sets of 5 with steady bar path and no failed reps.

phases.title: Build strength
phases.progressCheck: Complete 70 kg for 3 sets of 5 on a heavy day.

phases.title: Heavier fives
phases.progressCheck: Complete 75 kg for 3 sets of 5, or 2 sets of 5 plus 1 set of 4.

phases.title: Peak
phases.progressCheck: Complete 77.5 kg for 2 sets of 5 with the spotter present.

phases.title: Taper and test
phases.progressCheck: Attempt 80 kg for 5 reps with the spotter after a lighter week.

sessions.title: Heavy day: 60 kg 3x5
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Warm up with the empty bar and two lighter sets (e.g. 40 kg x5, 50 kg x3). Then 3 working sets of 5 at 60 kg in the rack with your spotter. Pause briefly on the chest, press with feet planted. Rest 3 minutes between sets.

targets.effort: hard but controlled, 1-2 reps left in each set
targets.progressMeasure: Log reps per set and how many reps you felt were left after the last set.

sessions.title: Technique day: 52.5 kg 3x5
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Lighter day to practise form. After warm-up, 3 sets of 5 at 52.5 kg. Lower the bar slowly (about 2 seconds), touch the same spot each rep, keep shoulders pinned. Rest 2 minutes.

targets.progressMeasure: Note whether every rep had the same touch point and a smooth press.

sessions.title: Heavy day: 60 kg 3x5
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Same warm-up as Monday, then 3 sets of 5 at 60 kg with your spotter. Aim for all sets to feel a little easier than Monday. Rest 3 minutes.

targets.effort: hard but controlled, 1-2 reps left in each set
targets.progressMeasure: Log reps left in the last set; if 2 or more, move to 62.5 kg next week.

sessions.title: Heavy day: 62.5 kg 3x5
sessions.descriptiveGuide: First step up. Warm up (40 kg x5, 50 kg x3, 57.5 kg x1), then 3 sets of 5 at 62.5 kg with your spotter. If a set stalls, the spotter helps and you log the reps you did alone. Rest 3 minutes.

targets.effort: hard, about 1 rep left in each set
targets.progressMeasure: Log reps completed without help in each set.

sessions.title: Technique day: 55 kg 3x5
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Lighter practice day. 3 sets of 5 at 55 kg, slow 2-second lowering, brief pause on the chest, then press. Rest 2 minutes.

targets.progressMeasure: Note if the pause on the chest stayed still and the bar path felt consistent.

sessions.title: Heavy day: 62.5 kg 3x5
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Repeat 62.5 kg for 3 sets of 5 with your spotter after the usual warm-up. Goal: all 15 reps on your own. Rest 3 minutes.

targets.effort: hard, 1-2 reps left in each set
targets.progressMeasure: If all 15 reps were done alone, plan 62.5 kg again next week, then 65 kg after.

options.rationale: Three bench days a week (heavy, volume, medium) with the top set rising about 2.5 kg every week or two from 60 kg, aiming at 80 kg for 5 reps by week 18. More weekly volume than steady, never reckless jumps.
assumptions: You keep 3 bench days a week with the rack and spotter present for heavy sets.
Most weeks you complete all planned reps with clean form before load goes up.
Progress may slow above 72.5 kg; repeating a week is normal, not failure.
No pain or injury interrupts training; stop and rest if pain appears.

phases.title: Base: own the 60s
phases.progressCheck: Week 4: heavy day 3x5 at 67.5 kg completed with all reps.

phases.title: Build volume and load
phases.progressCheck: Week 9: heavy day 3x5 at 72.5 kg completed; volume day 4x5 at 62.5 kg.

phases.title: Strength block
phases.progressCheck: Week 14: heavy day 3x5 at 77.5 kg or 5x3 at 80 kg completed with spotter.

phases.title: Peak toward 80 kg
phases.progressCheck: Week 16: 2x4 at 80 kg or 1x5 at 77.5 kg plus 1x3 at 80 kg completed.

phases.title: Taper and test
phases.progressCheck: Week 18: attempt 80 kg for 5 reps with spotter; log reps achieved.

sessions.title: Heavy day: 3x5 at 62.5 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Warm up with the empty bar and lighter sets (e.g. 40 kg x5, 50 kg x3). Then 3 working sets of 5 at 62.5 kg in the rack with your spotter. Controlled lowering, bar touches chest, press up. Rest 3 minutes between sets.

targets.effort: hard, about 1-2 reps left in reserve
targets.progressMeasure: Log reps per set and how many reps you felt were left after set 3.

sessions.title: Volume day: 4x5 at 55 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Warm up with lighter sets. Then 4 sets of 5 at 55 kg. Focus on the same bar path every rep and a brief pause on the chest. Rest 2 minutes between sets. Should feel moderate, not grinding.

targets.progressMeasure: Log whether all 20 reps were clean with a short chest pause.

sessions.title: Medium day: 3x6 at 57.5 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Warm up with lighter sets. Then 3 sets of 6 at 57.5 kg with your spotter nearby. Keep shoulders set and feet planted. Rest 2.5 minutes between sets.

targets.effort: moderately hard, 2-3 reps left in reserve
targets.progressMeasure: Log reps per set; note if the last reps slowed down.

sessions.title: Heavy day: 3x5 at 65 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Warm up as last week (empty bar, 40 kg x5, 50 kg x3, 57.5 kg x2). Then 3 sets of 5 at 65 kg with your spotter. If Monday last week left fewer than 1 rep in reserve, stay at 62.5 kg instead. Rest 3 minutes.

targets.effort: hard, about 1-2 reps left in reserve
targets.progressMeasure: Log load used, reps per set, and reps left in reserve on set 3.

sessions.title: Volume day: 4x5 at 57.5 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Warm up with lighter sets. Then 4 sets of 5 at 57.5 kg with a brief pause on the chest each rep. Rest 2 minutes between sets. Keep every rep smooth.

targets.progressMeasure: Log whether all 20 reps were completed with the pause.

sessions.title: Medium day: 3x6 at 60 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Warm up with lighter sets. Then 3 sets of 6 at 60 kg with your spotter. This is one more rep per set than your current 60 kg sets. Rest 2.5 minutes between sets.

targets.effort: moderately hard, 1-2 reps left in reserve
targets.progressMeasure: Log reps per set at 60 kg and compare with your baseline of 3x5.
